facts.fact: At the launch of the Ghana Card Number at Birth System on 14 March 2024, the news agency reported that a birth captured at a health facility is notified electronically to the Births and Deaths Registry's system, which issues a birth registration number and returns it to the facility's system; deaths are not mentioned.

systems.tiers: receives electronic birth notifications from health facilities and issues a birth registration number; the Registry's own offices are not described

systems.system: Ghana Card Number at Birth System
systems.owner: Ministry of Health, Ghana Health Service, Births and Deaths Registry and National Identification Authority, their systems integrated
systems.tiers: health facilities, for children from birth to six years; launched 14 March 2024 at Ga North Municipal Hospital, Accra
community health posts and health centres; deployed in 338 health facilities, which capture the newborn's details and notify the Registry's system

systems.owner: Ministry of Health / Ghana Health Service
systems.tiers: hospitals; captures the newborn's details and notifies the Registry's system

note: A launch-day description. The digital birth record is made in the Registry's central system on a health facility's notification, not at a registry office, so no value of 'made' or 'offices' is recorded; the 338 facilities are health facilities with e-tracker, not registration offices. Identity integrated: the system issues an identity number with the birth registration number.
